content: LiLi starts with the closed-world KBC approach path-ranking (PR) BIBREF11 , BIBREF17 and extends KBC in a major way to open-world knowledge base completion (OKBC). For a relation INLINEFORM0 , PR works by enumerating paths (except single-link path INLINEFORM1 ) between entity-pairs linked by INLINEFORM2 in the KB and use them as features to train a binary classifier to predict whether a query INLINEFORM3 should be in the KB. Here, a path between two entities is a sequence of relations linking them. In our work, we adopt the latest PR method, C-PR BIBREF16 and extend it to make it work in the open-world setting. C-PR enumerates paths by performing bidirectional random walks over the KB graph while leveraging the context of the source-target entity-pair. We also adopt and extend the compositional vector space model BIBREF20 , BIBREF21 with continual learning capability for prediction.
